text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, thank you so much for the 
wonderful birthday present~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're welcome! I had a great time too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, was playing catch with me 
really all you wanted for your present?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it has been quite a while, so it was 
truly delightful. It reminded me of my 
childhood days~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I used to invite you out all the 
time, didn't I? Asking you to come play 
outside with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Playing catch, footraces―― Ryan-oneesama 
taught me so many things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And that doesn't change here at Tracen 
Academy either. I will learn what is truly 
important for victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll have to keep running in a way 
that sets a good example! Let's both do 
our best, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I'll do my best practicing catch~. 
So that I can throw the ball straight to 
Ryan-onesama without it bouncing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm down to tag along with that as 
much as you want too!
